Tuition & Fees for Graduate Students
An advanced degree from Arkansas State University is a powerful investment in your
future, and we’re here to help you understand the cost. Whether you're pursuing a
master’s or doctoral degree, this page provides a clear breakdown of tuition, fees,
and tools to help you plan wisely.
A High-Value Graduate Experience
A-State graduate programs offer academic excellence at an affordable cost.
$5,233
In-state graduate tuition & required fees per semester (12 credit hours) **Additional
fees may apply
$31,080
Estimated annual cost for in-state graduate students
$75,310
Average starting salary for A-State master’s degree graduates
Understanding Graduate Tuition
Graduate tuition at A-State is determined by your residency status, total credit hours,
and your academic program. Mandatory fees support the resources and services that
enhance your graduate experience—from research labs to technology to campus facilities.
Here’s the breakdown:
Graduate Tuition & Fees: Calculated by multiplying the cost per credit hour and mandatory fees by your course
load.
Course Fees: Additional charges ranging from $5–$255 per course may apply depending on your class schedule.
Identity Compliance Fee: A $10/credit hour fee is applied to all online courses.
Distance Ed Technology Fee: A $10/credit hour fee is applied to all online courses.
Auditing Courses: Tuition and fees are the same whether auditing or taking a course for credit.
Waivers: You may be eligible for certain fee waivers. See if you qualify
